verdict.rationale: The only first-party programmatic interface in the evidence is the official Thoropass MCP server. It can list evidence requests and add comments, attachments and status updates to them, which is a thin, AI-assistant-oriented way to push evidence from outside the native integrations catalog. Nothing documents a general REST/public API, custom integration framework, or a way to push automated test results into monitors. Missing for 10: a documented public API for custom/private integrations, endpoints for pushing test or monitor results, API reference docs and auth/SDK details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
